business_problem: The All-China Federation of Trade Unions needed a unified AI foundation that could support legal aid, rights protection, and other worker services at national scale instead of leaving union service digitization fragmented across departments and regions.
solution_summary: The All-China Federation of Trade Unions built an AI support system with Baidu AI Cloud around a '1+4+N' architecture. The '1' is a union industry model designed to become a common intelligence base for union work. The '4' platform layers are a union large-model compute-scheduling platform, service-management platform, knowledge-operations platform, and AI-native application-support platform. Together those layers let the federation run model capabilities horizontally across departments and vertically across provinces with common standards and governance. On top of that foundation, 'N' applications can be added for labor legal aid, 12351 rights-protection services, worker innovation assistance, life services, health, education and training, and cultural scenarios.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports development of the shared union industry model and the model-driven service stack.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Supports creation of AI-native worker-service applications on top of the shared model foundation.

solution_components.name: Union Industry Model
solution_components.role: Acts as the common intelligence layer used across national and regional union service scenarios.

data_flow: Union knowledge, service content, and worker-service requests flow into the shared industry model and associated knowledge-operations platform. The system then serves applications such as legal aid and rights protection, while standardized model support is distributed across departments and provincial organizations.
business_outcome: The federation created a nationally governed AI foundation for union services, improved the speed and precision of legal-support scenarios, and reduced the time needed to deliver new AI service systems.
metrics: Delivery cycle fell from 3-6 months to under 1 month.
Access to effective information improved from weekly to hourly.
architecture_clues: The platform uses a '1+4+N' architecture with separate compute, service-management, knowledge-operations, and AI-native app-support layers
The deployment is designed for both horizontal use across departments and vertical rollout across provinces
The first example scenario includes legal answers, compensation calculation, and personalized case assessment for workers
evidence_quotes: The federation launched an action plan to build a unified and efficient AI 'union industry model' foundation and use AI services to support hundreds of millions of workers (original: 统筹构建全面统一、先进高效的人工智能“工会行业模型”底座。利用AI+服务，满足亿万职工群众需求).

The architecture is described as one industry model, four key platforms, and N applications including legal aid and 12351 rights-protection services (original: 建设一套1+4+N的人工智能应用支撑体系…N包括但不限于智能职工法律援助、智能12351维权服务).

The foundation achieved national standardization and provided model support horizontally across departments and vertically across provinces and cities (original: 实现了全国统一标准、统一规范、统一要求，实现了基于工会行业模型横向各部门、纵向各省市的大模型支撑能力).

In the legal-aid scenario, the system improved effective information support from weekly to hourly and shortened overall system delivery from 3-6 months to under 1 month (original: 得到有效信息支撑从周级到小时级…整套系统及应用的交付周期从3~6个月大幅缩短到1个月以内).
